about: A female NPC from Tripo (H3.1, Moti's full-body.jpg): an athletic woman in a grey sports top and briefs, a braid over her right shoulder, standing in an A-pose (arms out, legs apart, fingers open), facing -Y. One shell, 0 open edges. 1.70 m tall, chosen (a Viking woman beside the hero's 1.85 m). Rigged by Mixamo for Forge's humanoid path; every Forge move plays on her.
